elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The inserted paragraph covers only professional liability (E&O) and cyber/privacy insurance; no commercial general liability coverage or per-occurrence limit appears anywhere in the rendered language.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: No CGL coverage at all is required, so no aggregate limit is stated in the inserted Insurance paragraph.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted text requires 'professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000' — half the preferred USD 2,000,000 threshold.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted text requires 'cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000', below the preferred USD 5,000,000 level.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: No workers' compensation obligation appears in the inserted paragraph or elsewhere (searches for 'workers compensation' returned nothing operative).

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: The inserted paragraph contains no certificate-of-insurance delivery obligation; it ends at the cyber limit.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: 'Commerce One shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000' — Vendor-directed, mandatory, at the exact fallback amount.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: '...and cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000' — both cyber and privacy coverage named at the fallback floor.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: the inserted paragraph imposes a mandatory Vendor-side E&O covenant at USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability and privacy coverage at USD 2,000,000, with no undefined trigger and no conditionality.

Preferred level is incomplete on four elements (CGL 1M/2M, E&O at 2M, cyber at 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request); to reach preferred the drafter would need to add CGL per-occurrence and aggregate limits, raise E&O to USD 2,000,000, raise cyber to USD 5,000,000 for Customer Data processing, add a workers' compensation-as-required-by-law covenant, and add a certificates-on-request sentence.

Minimality holds: the insertion is confined to the two chosen fallback amounts and omits the model-language extras that would be non-minimal here — 'at its own expense', the term-plus-one-year survival tail, and the certificates sentence are all absent, and no existing wording of 14.9 or 14.10 was deleted or paraphrased.

Intent is preserved: the paragraph is added between 14.9 (Bankruptcy) and 14.10 (Complete Understanding) without disturbing either, creates no dangling cross-reference or undefined term, and does not contradict the Section 8 indemnity or limitation-of-liability allocation.

Drafting nit only (not a defect in operative substance): the inserted paragraph is captioned 'Insurance.' without a section number; consider numbering it (e.g., 14.10) and renumbering, or the parties may dispute its placement within the Miscellaneous article.
